shared.description: This sword once belonged to the great and terrible warrior Jaysun. It was said long ago that anyone who holds his power would be impossible to kill.
shared.notes:
Weapon was previously available from the quests Friday the 13th Invasion, Friday the 13th Invasion - Part II, Friday the 13th III, Friday the 13th Invasion - A Ghoulish Attack, and Friday the 13th Invasion Part IV.
The following changes were implemented on September 26th, 2025:
  • Level's requirement was raised from 10 to 13.
  • Damage range was modified from 21-35 to 28-32.
  • Crit was raised from +1 to +5.
  • Sellback was lowered from 500 to 13 Gold.
